native_destroy_rule.ENTRY: Capture original VkDevice scalar, original object scalar, original allocator pointer, actual kind/generation and owner association by value BEFORE delegate; membership for declared nonnull selected objects decided before tick. No native object memory read is required.
native_destroy_rule.RETURN: actual void/null, same token only; do not re-evaluate source expression device->vk_device or state->device after original, do not dereference native handle or original owner, do not manufacture ULONG0.
native_destroy_rule.historical_policy: A module can cease living after successful pipeline create while pipeline remains the historical emitted object. Pipeline/layout native lifetimes must satisfy actual relevant create/bind/emission/Execute cut. No lifetime/current Vulkan state query is inferred.

postreturn_invariants: Metadata AFTER routines accept frozen token and copied scalar/void only. No callback-specific lambda may rebuild receiver/owner fields from original object memory after delegate.
Freeze relevant SourceScope and class/owner fields at ENTRY; after only records returned scalar and changes observer state against the SAME immutable generation.
No original delegate is held under metadata mutex; observer error before/after never suppresses delegate/cleanup and cannot silently repair gap/drop/counters.
Lifetime of arguments does not imply storage remains alive throughout Release; the fixed callback field table must be interpreted with this destruction-specific exception.
None of these SOURCE observations establish current descriptor bytes, physical backing, owner of a renderer, or current GPU reads.
